args:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -n "${MEMPALACE_PALACE_PATH:-}" ]]; then
  palace_path="${MEMPALACE_PALACE_PATH}"
else
  if ! repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; then
    echo "mempalace-aria-nbv: not inside a Git repository; set MEMPALACE_PALACE_PATH" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  palace_path="${repo_root}/.artifacts/mempalace/palace"
fi
exec mempalace-mcp --palace "${palace_path}"
